law.preflight_and_run: Exact protected branch/head plus clean git status required before measurement.
law.verify_only: Exact protected branch/head remains mandatory, but dirt is admitted only after source-bound postrun classification.
law.tracked_baseline: Hash exact HEAD tree for WORKER_RETURNS/EE-P2X/LOCAL_COURT using git ls-tree + git show, rather than treating the directory as initially empty.
law.filesystem_baseline: Record premeasurement live-evidence files and all Git-ignored files.
law.common_admin: court/** and failures/COURT__COMMON__* are admitted only when parseable JSON recursively attributes itself to the selected source and does not contain the nonselected source.
law.ignored_runtime_byproduct: Only __pycache__/*.pyc deltas are classified as non-evidentiary Python runtime cache.
forbidden: repo mutation outside LOCAL_COURT except classified ignored .pyc
